change: Raise the per-kind IMAGE/IMAGEDEF source count from 384 to 512 and retain 128 group slots beyond that count for IMAGEDEF fixed fields. Keep the 64 KiB per-record payload, 4 MiB shared logical-retention budget and 256 KiB source-file gate.
checks: Locally generated 385 and 512 image sources with one shared or four definitions pass selected AC1021 and AC1024 graph audit, source-to-output independent readback, wrong-reactor-owner refusal with destination preservation, corrected retry and fresh library import. At 512, late entity mutation during staged output is also refused atomically and a corrected same-filter retry succeeds. The focused case passes 188 assertions.

A 513-image source is refused with its existing destination preserved; removing one image, exporting and importing the corrected source, then retrying with the same filter succeeds. The six-version existing boundary test, including 513 refusal and 512 corrected retry, passes 2250 assertions.

A shared IMAGEDEF with 512 reactors has 525 source groups. The former 512-group guard refused that graph; the new 640-group cap permits the checked source without relaxing either byte limit. The shared logical-budget and record-bound tests pass 1036 assertions.

A 512-definition source above the 256 KiB file gate remains refused with its destination intact; a corrected 384-definition source succeeds on retry (269 assertions). This is not admission of 512 distinct-definition files above that gate.

The 512-image mixed graph with 256 model-space and 256 named-block images, two definitions and late-mutation rollback passes in AC1021 and AC1032; independent ezdxf confirms source/output owners, definition and reactor closure and clean audits (120 assertions across all selected counts).

The AC1024 512-image graph with one 18- or 256-vertex polygon and one shared definition passes strict output, mutation refusal, corrected retry and fresh readback; 257 vertices remain refused. Independent ezdxf matches all selected image fields, vertices, IMAGEDEF scalar fields and graph links (4562 assertions across selected counts).
The bundled-codec LibreCAD library builds. No generated DWG or DXF fixture was committed.
limits: Selected locally generated ASCII DXF source graphs; no native 512-image GUI, independent producer, binary input, cross-version output, or other platform qualification.
513 images, more than 256 clipping vertices, source files above 256 KiB and profiles exceeding the shared logical memory budget remain outside the admitted profile.
The 4 MiB charge is logical retained storage, not an allocator-capacity or RSS measurement. Larger graphs require their own bound, closure, performance and independent readback evidence.
